sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collections" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "decks" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "parent_id" BLOB NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, parent_id) REFERENCES decks (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
CREATE TRIGGER decks_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON decks WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "parent_id" BLOB NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, parent_id) REFERENCES tags (collection_id, id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED);
CREATE TRIGGER tags_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON tags WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_types" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"));

CREATE TRIGGER note_types_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON note_types WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "note_type_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "source_kind" TEXT NULL, "source_reference" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("collection_id", "id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_type_id) REFERENCES note_types (collection_id, id), CHECK (source_reference IS NULL OR source_kind IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TRIGGER notes_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON notes WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_tags" ("collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "note_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "tag_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "tag_id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_id) REFERENCES notes (collection_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, tag_id) REFERENCES tags (collection_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE);
CREATE TRIGGER note_tags_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON note_tags WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_card_templates" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "note_type_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES note_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_cards" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "note_id" BLOB NOT NULL, "template_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES study_card_templates (id), "deck_id" BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("note_id", "template_id"), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, note_id) REFERENCES notes (collection_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (collection_id, deck_id) REFERENCES decks (collection_id, id));

CREATE TRIGGER study_cards_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON study_cards WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_assets" ("collection_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES collections (id), "hash" BLOB NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("collection_id", "hash"));

CREATE TRIGGER media_assets_collection_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF collection_id ON media_assets WHEN NEW.collection_id IS NOT OLD.collection_id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'collection_id is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "field_definitions" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "note_type_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES note_types (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_fields" ("note_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "field_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES field_definitions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("note_id", "field_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_events" ("id" BLOB NOT NULL, "study_card_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES study_cards (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "grade" TEXT NULL, "response_time" INTEGER NULL, "due_before" INTEGER NULL, "due_after" INTEGER NULL, "undone_event_id" BLOB NULL REFERENCES review_events (id), "scheduler_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduler_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "config_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduling_states" ("study_card_id" BLOB NOT NULL REFERENCES study_cards (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "due" INTEGER NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ease" REAL NULL, "step" INTEGER NOT NULL, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL, "review_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_event_id" BLOB NULL REFERENCES review_events (id), PRIMARY KEY ("study_card_id"));
CREATE INDEX decks_parent ON decks (collection_id, parent_id)
CREATE INDEX tags_parent ON tags (collection_id, parent_id)
CREATE INDEX note_types_collection ON note_types (collection_id)
CREATE INDEX field_definitions_note_type ON field_definitions (note_type_id)
CREATE INDEX study_card_templates_note_type ON study_card_templates (note_type_id)
CREATE INDEX notes_note_type ON notes (collection_id, note_type_id)
CREATE INDEX note_fields_field ON note_fields (field_id)
CREATE INDEX note_tags_tag ON note_tags (collection_id, tag_id)
CREATE INDEX study_cards_deck ON study_cards (collection_id, deck_id)
CREATE INDEX study_cards_template ON study_cards (template_id)
CREATE INDEX review_events_card ON review_events (study_card_id, at)
CREATE INDEX review_events_at ON review_events (at)
CREATE INDEX scheduling_states_due ON scheduling_states (state, due)
